CHATBOT.HELLO: Hello {{name}}! I'm the platform assistant. I can track an order, help you file a dispute or guide you to the right page.
CHATBOT.WHAT_ELSE: What can I do for you?
CHATBOT.ASK_ORDER_REF: What is the order reference? (e.g. ORD-AB12CD34). You can also type 'recent' to see your latest orders.
CHATBOT.PAY_HELP: About payments: 'Pending' = to process, 'Confirmed' = validated, 'Rejected/Cancelled' = closed. Do you want to see your pending payments?
CHATBOT.DELIVERY_HELP: A delivery goes through: assignment → acceptance → confirmation → reception. Confirmed reception automatically creates the payment.
CHATBOT.HUMAN: For a special case, describe it in a dispute: the relevant team will answer in the thread.
CHATBOT.NOT_UNDERSTOOD: I didn't understand '{{raw}}'. Here's what I can do:
CHATBOT.NO_RECENT: No recent orders found. Give me a reference (e.g. ORD-AB12CD34).
CHATBOT.RECENT_LIST: Here are your latest orders: pick one (type its reference).
CHATBOT.LOAD_ERROR: Cannot load orders. Please try again later.
CHATBOT.ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Order '{{ref}}' not found. Check the reference or type 'recent'.
CHATBOT.ORDER_NOT_FOUND_RETRY: Order '{{ref}}' not found. Retry or type 'recent'.
CHATBOT.NO_PENDING: Good news: no pending payments in the last 50.
CHATBOT.COMPLAINT_START: Describe the issue with the reference (e.g. 'broken parcel ORD-A1B2C3'): I'll file the dispute directly. Otherwise just give the reference or type 'recent'.
CHATBOT.DISPUTE_CREATED: Dispute filed for {{ref}}: '{{reason}}'. The relevant team will answer in the thread.
CHATBOT.DISPUTE_FAILED: Filing failed ({{err}}). Retry or use the order page.
CHATBOT.NO_RECENT_SHORT: No recent orders. Give me a reference to continue.
CHATBOT.ASK_REASON: Noted for {{ref}}. What is the reason?
CHATBOT.DESCRIBE_ONE_SENTENCE: Describe the issue in one sentence:
CHATBOT.CONFIRM_COMPLAINT: I'll open a dispute for {{ref}} — reason: '{{reason}}'. Confirm?
CHATBOT.TITLE: Assistant
